items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: today actually the DIVA Jazz Orchestra was scheduled to be in San Paolo, Brazil with Nneena Freelon

ctx.x: You might like it, being six feet away.

Yeah. With earplugs. Only kidding. But yeah, well this is just complete Twilight Zone time for all of us. Very crazy. And you know I will share, well today actually the DIVA Jazz Orchestra was scheduled to be in San Paolo, Brazil with Nneena Freelon, so we have had — one of the many festivals that were cancelled with all of my groups. So it’s painful and surreal to see all of those opportunities leave, and then, and with no end in sight for when we possibly will recoup even the smallest bit of live performance.…
Were any of the people that cancelled, did they try to do their best to say well we’re going to reschedule?
